name: context-mode
description: Context window optimization for AI coding agents. Sandboxes tool output (98% reduction), persists session memory, and enforces routing across 17 platforms via MCP + hooks.
one_liner: A plugin that keeps AI coding assistants from 'forgetting' what they were doing, by trimming the clutter they see and remembering context between sessions.
buyer: An indie developer or small dev team paying for multiple AI coding subscriptions who is frustrated by their assistant losing track of a project between sessions.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer uses it to keep long client projects coherent across many AI coding sessions without re-explaining context each time.
A dev tools startup bundles it as a premium feature inside their own AI coding product.
A dev team standardizes on it to cut their AI API usage costs by reducing wasted context tokens.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a hosted/managed version with team dashboards and shared memory across a company's developers.
License the routing/sandboxing engine to AI coding tool vendors.

steal_this: Package it as a one-click 'stop losing context' plugin for a specific popular AI coding tool and sell a pro tier with team memory sharing.
